Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 宿五松山下荀媪家 — 李白
我宿五松下，寂寥无所欢。
田家秋作苦，邻女夜舂寒。
跪进雕胡饭，月光明素盘。
令人惭漂母，三谢不能餐。
Historical posture essential: the elderly woman is KNEELING upright on a woven floor mat, visibly bent knees on the ground, presenting the plain shallow rice plate with both hands. The guest is seated low on another mat beside a low table. No chairs, no standing woman. Respectful hospitality, no humiliation. Keep all figures small in the top 30 percent.
